feedback: Pre-race review. Nothing has raced for this candidate, so this states no outcome for it. The candidate is valid: all five sensor positions are inside the limits, sensor weights match the five sensors, and kp 2.5, ki 0.5, kd 0.3, base_speed 1.5 and last_direction are inside their ranges. It changes one field from the best raced design (iteration 8, score 46.1311): controller.kd from 0.2 to 0.3, with geometry, kp, ki, base_speed and line_loss unchanged. The evidence for trying more derivative action is that iteration 8's oval steering_oscillation rose to 0.17 and line_loss_events to 1.7 when base_speed went from 1.4 to 1.5 (iteration 7 to 8). Iterations 3 to 5 showed that gain changes at base_speed 1.4 moved the score by under 0.5, but kd 0.1 to 0.2 at 1.4 (iteration 4 to 5) did reduce oval oscillation slightly (0.113 to 0.111) with no harm to s-bend or slalom progress. Iteration 9 is not used as a base because kp 2.0 lowered the score to 41.30. This is a cheap, single-field test of the best design, so approve it. Do not treat the rationale's expected oscillation and line-loss reductions as measured. Use the next race as follows. (a) If oval line_loss_events is at or below 1.7 and oval progress is at or above 0.2657, with s-bend progress near 0.0416, keep kd 0.3. Only one iteration remains after this one, so consider base_speed 1.6 in that final iteration with kd 0.3 unchanged, since the 1.4 to 1.5 step gave the largest measured gain (oval progress 0.2261 to 0.2657). (b) If oval progress falls below 0.2657 or line_loss_events rises above 1.7, revert kd to 0.2, which is the best raced design. (c) If noise_robustness drops clearly while oscillation does not fall, the derivative is amplifying sensor noise; revert kd to 0.2 rather than raising it further.
requested_changes: After the race, if oval line_loss_events stays at or below iteration 8's 1.7 and oval progress is at or above 0.2657, keep controller.kd at 0.3 and, in the final iteration, test controller.base_speed 1.6 with all other fields unchanged, citing the 1.4 to 1.5 step's oval progress gain (0.2261 to 0.2657).

If oval progress falls below iteration 8's 0.2657 or line_loss_events rises above 1.7, set controller.kd back to 0.2 with kp 2.5, ki 0.5 and base_speed 1.5, since iteration 8 is the best raced design at 46.1311.

If noise_robustness falls while steering_oscillation does not drop, do not raise kd further; revert to kd 0.2 (iteration 8), since derivative action at the outer sensors may be amplifying sensor noise.
